project_context.name: Facil Labs - Recibo Fácil / BelegGuard
project_context.description: A bilingual (DE, PT-BR, EN), local-first mobile app for managing food expiry and storing receipts/warranties. Android-first, privacy-friendly, zero cloud.

theme.rationale: Patients/users need warmth, calm, trust for personal utility. Avoid clinical dark mode or generic 'tech SaaS' blue.

typography.rules: Never center-align long text. Use font-light for elegance and bold for strong data points.

layout_strategies.home_screen: Bento-style modular layout. Top section features two equal-weight large cards for 'Scan Food' and 'Save Receipt'. Below: horizontally scrolling 'Expiring Soon' items, followed by a tight list of 'Recent Receipts'.
layout_strategies.navigation: Bottom tab bar: Home, Inventory (Vorräte), Receipts (Belege), Search, Settings. Clean icons, active state uses primary color and a subtle pill background.
layout_strategies.add_flow: Use Bottom Sheets for adding details post-scan/photo. Keeps user context anchored without aggressive full-screen modal switches.
layout_strategies.empty_states: Minimalist. Use a single Phosphor/Lucide icon with text. No loud illustrations.

components.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px inner border. Shadow: 0px 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.04). No sharp floating dropshadows.
components.buttons: Large radius (16px) for primary actions. Text must have APCA-compliant contrast. Avoid generic blue.
components.inputs: Solid background (#F2F2F0) with no border. On focus: add a 2px stroke of primary color. Label above input in caption style.
components.lists: Card-less list items. Left icon/thumbnail, title & date stacked, right-aligned status. Subtle bottom border separator only.

technical_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='scan-barcode-button'.
technical_rules.file_extension: MUST use .js extensions (not .tsx) for all React Native component files.
technical_rules.i18n: Implement dictionary mapping for 'de', 'pt-BR', fallback 'en'. Keys should be descriptive (e.g. home.actions.scanFood).
technical_rules.state_management: Use local storage (e.g. AsyncStorage, SQLite) ONLY. No cloud sync. Local notifications (Expo Notifications) for expiry/warranty alerts.
technical_rules.accessibility: Touch targets minimum 48x48. High contrast text. Native accessible labels for screen readers.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, clean and elegant. Avoid heavy filled icons except for active navigation tabs.
